customManagers.description: Swift releases. swiftlang/swift tags them swift-X.Y.Z-RELEASE. Version and commit are captured by ONE regex so Renovate moves them together -- verify-relocatable.sh asserts the clone of SWIFT_TAG is exactly SWIFT_SHA, so a version bumped without its commit fails closed.
The swiftlang/llvm-project commit the build support is cut from. Branch and digest captured together so the branch stays authoritative in pins.env rather than duplicated here.

packageRules.description: A PATCH Swift bump is self-contained now: the tag and download URL derive from SWIFT_VERSION, SWIFT_SHA moves with it, and the .pkg is verified by signer identity rather than a hash nobody can predict. Let it merge on its own -- but only after the build passes, hence ignoreTests:false above.
A MINOR or MAJOR Swift bump is NOT self-contained: LLVM_BRANCH is swift/release/<minor> and has to follow, which no regex here can infer. Needs a human.
